name: Task_10
description:
Simulate bulk Aluminum at 300 K to measure its reference energy and validate thermostat equipartition. Start with a conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Aluminum (a = 4.05 \u00c5) expanded into a 3 \u00d7 3 \u00d7 3 supercell. Use the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as the calculator. Conduct molecular dynamics simulations in the canonical (NVT) ensemble at 300 K, choosing suitable thermostat, integration, equilibration, production, and sampling settings. Initialize velocities for 300 K. Equilibrate for at least 2 ps and retain at least 3 ps of production, using a timestep 1 fs and at least 32 production samples spaced at most 100 fs apart; extend sampling until the stage is settled.

Use the supplied checkpoint without dispersion and keep the 108-atom cell fixed. Initialize momenta once with a recorded seed, remove center-of-mass momentum once, and preserve positions and momenta during the calculation. The evaluator derives the mean total energy per atom and overall and directional temperatures for this single 300 K stage. Retain the calculation log with your own code.
